subject: Proper ways to avoid repetition in server.r code.

messages.author: 40a63e579feba2c0
messages.subject: Proper ways to avoid repetition in server.r code.
parts:
Hello Shiny expert,


I'm learning Shiny, and my App looks good, slightly slow, since I believe I did repeated some blocks of code inside server.r.

Wondering how can I reduce this repetition.


For example:

This code below been repeated many times, so what is the best way to organize these and make it as one reactive table that I can use it in all the server without repeating it in each plot or table.

Thanks in advance.

 
    top_HRs_Changed <- HR_DeltaCalc %>% 
      filter(input$variablex == kpi) %>%
      arrange(desc(deltaDiff)) %>% 
      slice(1:input$nlabels) %>% 
      select(network.element)

        # Filter the selected data
    fltrd_data <- cellMapData %>% select(newDate, cellName, eNodeB, contains(input$variablex))     
    # Rename the column inside the fltrd_data to make the sorting easier instead od using the row counter column name:
    colnames(fltrd_data)[4] <- "KPI_focus"
    # To remove the % sign from the columns
    fltrd_data$KPI_focus = as.numeric(gsub("%", " ", fltrd_data$KPI_focus))

    fltrd_data$top_HR <- factor(fltrd_data$cellName, levels = c(as.character(top_HRs_Changed$network.element), "Other"))
    fltrd_data$top_HR[is.na(fltrd_data$top_HR)] <- "Other"
